title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2019

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) Order 2019.

2.—(1) Income comprising dividends amounting to £8,883,325 that are received in Singapore by Frasers Property (Europe) Holdings Pte. Ltd. (a company incorporated in Singapore) from Frasers Property (UK) Limited (a company incorporated in the United Kingdom) for the year of assessment 2015, is exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption under sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the terms and conditions specified in paragraphs 3 and 4 of the letter of approval dated 26 November 2018 addressed to KPMG Services Pte. Ltd., the tax agent of Frasers Property (Europe) Holdings Pte. Ltd.
